name: Dr. Shahrukh Khan
photoNote: Photo placeholder — upload via CMS to public/images/uploads/
credentials: MBBS, MS Ortho, DNB Ortho, MNAMS, FIJR, FIASM, DIP FIFA Sports Medicine
about: Dr. Shahrukh Khan is a co-director and senior orthopaedic consultant at Dashvanth Healthcare, and Consultant Orthopaedic Surgeon at Sanjeevan Hospital, Daryaganj and Apollo Spectra, Karol Bagh (since May 2025). He completed his MBBS and MS (Orthopaedics) from Maulana Azad Medical College (MAMC) & Lok Nayak Hospital, New Delhi — one of India's most prestigious medical institutions — followed by DNB (Orthopaedic Surgery) from the National Board of Examinations.

He further specialised with a Senior Residency in Sports Medicine at the Sports Injury Centre, Safdarjung Hospital & VMMC (the premier government sports injury centre in India), and completed a Fellowship in Arthroscopy & Arthroplasty at Max Hospital, Mohali. He also holds a Diploma in FIFA Sports Medicine, making him one of the very few orthopaedic surgeons in East Delhi with international-level sports medicine credentials.

Dr. Shahrukh has 7 peer-reviewed publications in indexed international journals including the Indian Journal of Orthopaedics, JBJS Essential Surgical Techniques, Journal of Orthopaedic Science, and Annals of the National Academy of Medical Sciences. He has won multiple academic awards including the Silver Medal at E-DOACON 2020 and presented at the SICOT World Congress, Egypt (2023). He has attended 21+ orthopaedic workshops and trained at AIIMS, MAMC, and premier orthopaedic institutions across India.

name: Dr. Simranjeet Singh
photoNote: Photo placeholder — upload via CMS to public/images/uploads/
credentials: MBBS (MAMC), M.Ch Neurosurgery (AIIMS), Fellowship Endovascular Neurosurgery (GB Pant)
about: Dr. Simranjeet Singh is a highly trained neurosurgeon and Director of Dashvanth Healthcare. He currently serves as Consultant Neurosurgeon at Max Smart Superspeciality Hospital, Saket, New Delhi — one of India's premier tertiary care neurosurgical centres.

He completed his MBBS from Maulana Azad Medical College (MAMC), New Delhi (2010–2015), and his M.Ch Neurosurgery from the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi (2017–2022). He served as Chief Resident at AIIMS (2022–2023), before undertaking a Fellowship in Endovascular Neurosurgery at GB Pant Institute, New Delhi (2023–2024).

He was subsequently appointed Assistant Professor of Neurosurgery at GB Pant Hospital (Oct 2024 – Apr 2025), followed by Associate Consultant and then Consultant Neurosurgeon at Max Smart Superspeciality Hospital, Saket (2025–Present). Dr. Simranjeet specialises in complex brain tumour surgery, endovascular coiling and flow diversion for cerebral aneurysms, minimally invasive spine surgery, mechanical thrombectomy for acute stroke, and craniovertebral junction disorders. He has 7 peer-reviewed publications and won 1st Prize at the SkullBaseCon 2024 Young Neurosurgeons' session.

name: Dr. Rupali Raj
photoNote: Photo placeholder — upload via CMS to public/images/uploads/
credentials: MBBS — Lady Hardinge Medical College, Delhi; MS Obstetrics & Gynaecology — GTB Hospital, Delhi; FMAS — Minimally Invasive Surgery (AMASI, Hyderabad)
about: Dr. Rupali Raj is a highly experienced Obstetrician and Gynaecologist with over 8 years in medicine, trained at two of Delhi's most prestigious institutions — Lady Hardinge Medical College (MBBS) and Guru Tegh Bahadur Hospital (MS Obs & Gynae). She has further specialised in minimally invasive surgery (FMAS) from AMASI, Hyderabad.

Most recently, Dr. Rupali served as an Obstetrician/Gynaecologist at AIIMS Patna, where she managed complex high-risk pregnancies including severe anaemia, gestational diabetes, pre-eclampsia, eclampsia, HELLP syndrome, placenta accreta spectrum, and malpresentations. She has overseen numerous births annually, including planned caesareans and emergency deliveries.

At Dashvanth Healthcare, Dr. Rupali brings AIIMS-calibre women's healthcare to East Delhi — offering expert consultations in pregnancy care, gynaecological surgery, fertility evaluation, and reproductive health for women of all ages.
